name: Improved Burn (Monster)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Burn, Ability Focus (burn)

Benefit(s): When you are hit with a manufactured weapon, that weapon takes fire damage as though hit by your attack, and the creature wielding it must make a Reflex save (DC 10 + 1/2 your Hit Dice + your Constitution modifier) to avoid catching on fire.
